title: Hypergeometric Draw Odds
description:
A hypergeometric distribution is a statistical method for calculating the probability of k successes in n draws from a finite population without replacement.

In Spire terms: what are the odds I have weakness next turn? Can I kill in two? Should I break Pocketwatch to block an extra 3? What are the odds that I draw 3 Withers next turn with Fiddle and die??

This mod exists to help you calculate the chance of getting specific cards in specific draws.

Features include:

- "All Cards" view from combat showing your draw pile, followed by the cards in your reshuffle (discard + cards in hand).
- Hover tooltips showing the chance of drawing a specific card or any exact copy of that card.
- Calculates percentage chance of drawing X out of Y selected cards, given the next N cards drawn from your deck.
- Accounts for relic or draw powers (e.g. pocketwatch, fiddle, pollinous core) in setting the size of your next draw.
- "Sim Draw" option to see what your upcoming draws might look like.
- "Rawdog" mode if you prefer to just enter the numbers by hand.
- Gamepad navigation fully supported.

Note that you can map the mod's All Cards view to your Draw Pile button via the Mod Settings ('Override Draw Pile button')

Feedback and feature requests always welcome!

Source code and issue tracker:
https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-hypergeo
changeNote:
v0.13.0

- Every section heading and every checkbox in the shelf now explains itself on hover.
- Settings - Mod Settings carries a default for each view option, so the All Cards screen opens the way you like it every run. Changing an option in the screen itself still works, and lasts until you close the game.
- The Simulate Draw section keeps both of its buttons on screen. Reset greys out when there is no dealt draw to put away, rather than appearing and disappearing.

v0.12.0

- New 'Simulate' section. Press Draw to deal a hand at random from the draw pile, and from the reshuffle if the draw pile runs out. The cards take over the grid and turn over one at a time; deal again as often as you like, and Reset puts the real piles back. The cards are sampled rather than read off the top of the draw pile, so this shows you what the percentages mean rather than what you are about to draw. A dealt hand is put away whenever it stops describing the board it came from.
- Fixed Pendulum, which was counted twice and a turn early. A fresh Pendulum showing 0 was predicted to draw its bonus next turn; it does not pay out until it shows 2.
- Section markers in the grid use the Compendium's plaque, which reads better against the cards and finally centres its text.
- Fixed the gamepad dropping out of the screen onto the relic bar behind it, most often after pressing a Reset button — which hides itself, and took the focus with it.

v0.11.0

- Requires game version 0.110 or later. The 0.110 update reworked how the game stores keyboard bindings, splitting them into separate mouse-and-keyboard and keyboard-only sets, and earlier builds of this mod cannot run on it. If you are on 0.110, update; if you are still on 0.109, stay on v0.10.1.
- The All Cards shortcut now appears in every column of Settings - Input, including the new keyboard-only one, and still defaults to W in each.
- New 'Combine Same Card Odds' option, on by default. The odds shown on a card are the odds of drawing any copy of it, which is usually the question worth asking and matches the number in its hover tip. Turn it off and each copy is asked about on its own, which is worth doing when the copies sit in different piles.
- The back button no longer crowds the options along the bottom of the shelf.

v0.10.1

- Fixed a gap that could appear under the Draw Chance tooltip when several tooltips were on screen at once, and the odd column wrapping that came with it near the top of the screen. The tooltip was reserving more height than it drew.

v0.10.0

- The combat button now shows % rather than ALL, and has a hover tip naming the screen and its current shortcut key.
- Cards left out of the reshuffle get their own 'In Hand' section, between Reshuffle and Retained, instead of being shown as Retained. Both mean a card cannot be drawn, but for different reasons.
- The grid separators are just the section name now, with what the section holds moved to a hover tip.
- The option checkboxes all sit at one size.

v0.9.0

- New 'Include Hand in Reshuffle' option. On by default, since the usual question is about next turn's hand. Turn it off to ask about drawing more cards during this turn: your hand then stays put, so it is not reshuffled, it still takes up space in hand, and it moves to the Retained section.
- The Hits count can now be zero, answering 'what are the odds I draw none of these' — worth asking of a card you would rather not see.
- A Reset button clears the selection.
- The Draw Chance sentence names every selected card instead of trailing off after three.
- Odds show two decimal places, and a chance too small to display reads '< 0.01 %' rather than rounding to zero.
- The grid separators are restyled to match the shelf's own headings.
- Rawdog Mode's labels name their statistical terms on hover: Population, Sample Size, Successes in population, Successes in sample.
